name: CheapShark Game Deals API
summary: Free API aggregating PC game prices and deals across Steam, GOG, Humble, Fanatical and other stores, with historical lows.
description: CheapShark tracks current sale and normal prices of PC games across many digital stores. Endpoints list deals with filters (store, price range, Metacritic and Steam rating), look up a game with all its current store prices and cheapest price ever, list the stores and create price alerts. No key is needed.

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.notes: An empty User-Agent returned 400 asking for a descriptive one; the default curl User-Agent returned 400 on /games too.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented on the pages fetched.

endpoints.summary: Current deals with filters and sorting
Search games by title or steamAppID
All store deals and cheapest price ever for one game

license.name: Not stated; free API, no data license found

agent_notes: Search /games?title= first to get a gameID, then /games?id= for per-store deals. Prices are strings in USD. dealID values are URL-encoded; pass them on as returned.
caveats: Deal listing can be slow (3.3 s for pageSize=2 today).
/deals returns at most 60 rows per page (pageSize=100 returned 60) and an x-total-page-count header.
Refresh cadence is not documented; update_frequency is a best guess.
The www.cheapshark.com/redirect link for a dealID answered 403 to curl, so only browsers can follow deal links.
